name: Drensteinfurt (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided blue over white, charged at the centre with the city arms of Drensteinfurt (a white stag on blue above a wall).
history: Municipal flag of Drensteinfurt; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Drensteinfurt arms — white stag on blue above a wall
